name: Icon Browser
author: Brett
description: Browse every icon the framework ships (framework/icon-library: 7 open-licensed sets, 11,700 glyphs as icon-pack assets) and every pack you add, as a tree, a grid or a list: categorized, sortable, filterable, searchable, with thumbnails in the tree you can switch off. Icon sources of any kind (local folder, HTTP, REST, MCP, FTP / SFTP, Google Drive, Google Photos, Dropbox, known online repositories) with per-type forms and secrets in a private store. Compose packs by dragging icons between collapsible, floatable panes and save them as icon-pack assets; open selected icons into docked or floating tab groups. The Icon Manager: every UI and plugin has an icon map (icon-map@1); list them by app, edit a map or drop icons onto a live preview, Save / Apply, inherit root → UI → plugin, switch packs, Randomize, Generate a cohesive set. Nav → Plugins → Icon browser; settings in Settings → Plugins → Icon browser.
